g.text: Round83: U6 four-arm comparison at a common 3600-second cap
Markers are audited checkpoints; dashed lines only guide the eye. Missing U leaves U/gap blank; L is shown as recorded.
Whole elapsed time includes startup, all native calls and exit. An outlined square marks a valid hard-stop endpoint if present.
U6: V50/M4/Q30, mathematical T18000; exposed development on one common qualified build.
